steps.title: Initialize Project Structure
steps.description: Set up files and direct package parameters for the Ludo Classic application.

steps.title: Configure Build Script
steps.description: Configure compileSdk, targetSdk, and base build tools in app/build.gradle with Gradle 8.5 compatibility.

steps.title: Implement AndroidManifest.xml
steps.description: Establish correct package references and set screen orientation to portrait to lock vertical game board rendering.

steps.title: Design Classic board coordinates
steps.description: Implement standard 52-cell track coordinates and relative home pathways for Red, Green, Yellow, and Blue players.

steps.title: Create Custom DiceView
steps.description: Implement a custom rendering DiceView class with 2D Canvas dots drawings and rapid rotation animations.

steps.title: Create Custom LudoBoardView
steps.description: Implement 15x15 cell color mapping, big circular Yards, safe star zones, and centered triangular destinations in custom LudoBoardView.

steps.title: Implement Overlapping Token Clustering
steps.description: Write an advanced drawing loop inside LudoBoardView to represent multiple tokens occupying the same coordinates with balanced group layouts.

steps.title: Design Layout activity_main.xml
steps.description: Design the UI containing title headings, player mode select buttons, Board View card, interactive dice, and dynamic stats grids.

steps.title: Implement Pass-and-Play Turn Logic
steps.description: Program multiplayer turn cycles inside MainActivity supporting both 2-Player (Red/Yellow) and 4-Player variants.

steps.title: Integrate Animated Step-by-Step Movement
steps.description: Develop a recursive runnable scheduler that moves tokens cell-by-cell with haptic ticks to provide professional motion feedback.

steps.title: Integrate Token Collision Mechanism
steps.description: Write cut checks that return targeted opponent pawns back to their home Yard unless positioned safely on standard star cells.

steps.title: Implement Automated Pass Handling
steps.description: Configure automatic turn rotation if a dice roll generates no eligible moves for active pawns.

steps.title: Verify Manifest Namespace and Quality Assurance
steps.description: Verify xmlns:android is fully valid to complete code assembly cleanly.

steps.title: Building Ludo Classic
steps.description: Compile, bundle and optimize the native Ludo Classic application.
